content: {"episode_id":"ep-05163","cpt":"93226","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93226 was performed as part of a 48-hour Holter monitoring study ordered for a patient with recurrent palpitations consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1), episodes of dizziness (R42), and a recent syncopal event (R55). The monitoring was medically necessary to correlate these symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmic activity and to guide further management, as documented in the clinical indication note. We therefore request reconsideration of the PR-204 denial for CPT 93226 in light of the documented clinical indications."}
